_readme: Real reports used to evaluate season stability and accuracy. `expected` holds the label the eval scores against (undertone / contrast / season / subseason; any field may be omitted). `labelSource` says who set it: "stylist" is ground truth, "proposed" is Claude's read from the photos and needs a stylist's confirmation before it is treated as truth. The eval prints agreement across runs and hits against `expected`.

cases.label: dark-chestnut hair, brown eyes, medium skin with a slight cool lean (portrait hue 46.8–49.2° on three shoots); production gave soft autumn / deep autumn / cool summer on three runs
cases.note: Stylist 2026-09-06: Cool Summer. Skin pink-neutral without peach or olive; cheek and nose redness is vascular flush, not autumn warmth. Hair dark chestnut, ashy, greying at the temples — no mahogany or golden glint. Eye whites white, not cream. Not Soft Summer (too deep and contrasty for oatmeal / dusty rose as a base), not Deep Winter (chroma is greyed, not clear — Black / Ruby / Snow would be a costume), not Autumn (camel / rust / mustard / warm olive would yellow the face; navy grey, slate, spruce, dusty blue, charcoal sit right). The model's warm/autumn read comes from room light and flush; the 66.6° warm measurement in production came from forearms of another shoot. Contrast deliberately unlabelled until the hair measurement is stable — Cool Summer holds with medium or high given dark hair and brown eyes.
